gallery.title: Wallet health check
gallery.description: Each Sunday evening, reads your Trust Wallet through its Agent Kit: what you hold and what it's worth, how prices moved, and a risk check on every token, flagging any that look like scams or have little liquidity. Emailed to you. It only reads: it never sends, swaps or approves.
gallery.tip: Needs Trust Wallet's Agent Kit (npm install -g @trustwallet/cli) as MCP_TRUSTWALLET in second-thought.ini: the example ini shows how. Change the email address to yours.
gallery.author: itsfja

fields.TEXT: Read my Trust Wallet: the wallet's status, then its portfolio (every token, how much, and its value). For each token, get its price now and run a risk check. Then write a short summary: the total value, each holding and its share, and a section headed 'Worth a look' listing any token whose risk check is medium or high, with the reasons it gave. Only read: don't send, swap, approve or pay for anything.
